a.xlink:title: Infrastructure:AreaOfInterest: A functional urban area of interest, such as a school, commercial or residential zone.
Infrastructure:UrbanEntity: Any entity of the urban and peri-urban environment considered in mobility modelling. It is the top class of the…
Infrastructure:Arrow_markings: Directional arrows painted on the road surface to indicate traffic flow and vehicle movements.
Infrastructure:Road_markings: Road surface markings that guide traffic, such as lane lines, crosswalks and directional arrows.
Infrastructure:bicycle: A human-powered two-wheeled vehicle, used on streets, bicycle lanes and sometimes sidewalks.
Infrastructure:vehicle: A motorised or non-motorised means of transport used on roads to move people or goods.
Infrastructure:Bicycle_lane_marking: Ground markings indicating a lane or a space reserved for cyclists, with specific symbols or signs.
Infrastructure:Building: A building located along a street.
Infrastructure:Bus: A road vehicle that runs on fixed routes for public or private transport.
Infrastructure:Cars: A four-wheeled motor vehicle, used mainly for personal transport.
Infrastructure:Charging_station: A place where electric vehicles, including DRT shuttles, can be charged.
Infrastructure:DRT_Shuttle: A vehicle temporarily assigned to the demand-responsive transport (DRT) service. It can stop playing this role without…
Infrastructure:Hospital: A hospital building, an important destination of DRT trips.
Infrastructure:Industrial_Zone: An area where economic activities, such as industry, are concentrated.
Infrastructure:Intersection: A junction where several streets meet, where vehicles and pedestrians follow signage to take the right direction.
Infrastructure:Lidar_sensor: A sensor that uses laser light to measure distances and detect objects.
Infrastructure:Sensor: A device that collects traffic data, such as vehicle speed, traffic volume or density on a road.
Infrastructure:Municipalities: A municipality: the territory of a city or a town, delimited in space and represented by a polygon or a multipolygon.…
Infrastructure:Neighborhood: A geographically delimited urban area that comprises streets, points of interest and other urban infrastructure…
Infrastructure:Obstacles: An object or a structure on the street that may block or slow down vehicles or pedestrians.
Infrastructure:Parking: A designated area for parking vehicles, such as a car park or parking spaces.
Infrastructure:Parking_markings: Markings that indicate parking spaces on the road or in car parks.
Infrastructure:Pedestrian_crossing: A zebra-style road marking that shows a pedestrian crossing.
Infrastructure:Pedestrians: People walking along streets, crossing roads or using sidewalks.
DRT:Person: A person involved in the DRT service: a customer, a passenger, a driver or an administrator.
Infrastructure:Radar_sensor: A sensor that uses radio waves to detect the speed and position of vehicles and other objects.
Infrastructure:Road_segment: A portion of road between two reference points, such as intersections or stops. Its identity is determined by its…
Infrastructure:RondAbout: A roundabout: a circular intersection where traffic flows around a central island.
Infrastructure:School: A school building, an important destination of DRT trips.
Infrastructure:Shuttle: A small vehicle that carries passengers along a fixed route, for public or private transit in a specific area.
Infrastructure:Sidewalk: A paved pathway adjacent to a street, intended for pedestrian use.
Infrastructure:Streets: A street used by vehicles and pedestrians, made of one or more road segments.
Infrastructure:Traffic_control: The signs, traffic lights and road markings that regulate traffic and warn or inform drivers and pedestrians.
Infrastructure:Traffic_light: A traffic signal that controls the movement of vehicles and pedestrians with red, amber and green lights.
Infrastructure:Traffic_signs: A road sign giving traffic information, such as a speed limit, a restriction or a direction.
Infrastructure:Weather_sensor: A sensor that detects and reports weather conditions, such as rain, fog, or wind, which can affect traffic.
